hook_line: INDIAN-AMERICAN CANDIDATES FACE THE EARLY VOTE

hook_stat.sub: Spent against Amish Shah in Arizona's 1st Congressional District

stats.label: Spent against Pia Dandiya in Florida's 22nd District
Palm Beach County early voting sites, open through November 1

diaspora_bullets: Amish Shah in Arizona and Pia Dandiya in Florida are in congressional races rated toss-up to tilt
Vivek Ramaswamy is running for Ohio governor, and Saritha Komatireddy is challenging New York Attorney General Letitia James
news_summary: Early voting is under way in the states where Indian-American candidates face their toughest races, ahead of the November 3 midterms.
payoff: The toss-up ratings in Arizona and Florida mean the Indian-American presence in the next Congress could hinge on a few thousand early and absentee ballots.
